control.legacyHint: Legacy v1 retains sequential execution, OR incoming edges and string conditions; no automatic v2 conversion.
control.name: Name
control.uniqueName: Names must be nonempty and unique
control.callIsolation: Child variables are isolated; only successful explicit outputs publish. Remote effects and cookies do not roll back. v1 children retain existing script dependencies.
control.countBudget: Count cannot exceed the iteration limit
control.loopHint: Zero iterations publish no outputs. A true while predicate after the limit fails. Data rows and loop iterations are independent; suite rows do not advance implicitly.
control.parallelHint: AND output targets must not conflict. OR publishes only the recorded winner, cancels losers and waits for drain. Branch variables and cookies are isolated; cookies never merge into the parent.
control.allowSideEffects: I confirm repeated remote side effects
control.retryHint: Every retry repeats all selected data rows and original container operations for this request node. Remote effects and cookies do not roll back. Non GET/HEAD/OPTIONS requires confirmation; even GET may have side effects and a failure does not prove the server received nothing.
control.recover: Recover eligible failure on handler success
control.cancelCleanupHint: User/ancestor cancellation, root deadline or OR loss starts no new network handler or finally. Started calls must drain. Local timeout handlers have independent bounded signals and cannot extend the root deadline.
control.runInputs: Run inputs (blank uses default or omits)
control.requestFacts: Protocol facts: started {started} / completed {completed} / HTTP exchanges {http}
control.currentAssetHint: Locates the current asset; no historical snapshot replay.
control.findings: Draft findings (saving allowed; resolve before run/enable)
control.fanOut: Ordinary nodes cannot fan out implicitly
control.conditionPorts: Condition successors must use distinct true/false ports
